messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: document management system - Sat 11 Jan
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's DMS will be unavailable on Saturday 11 January between 06:00 and 10:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please save and close any checked-out documents before Friday evening. No action is required during the window.

IT Helpdesk
